entry.k: A Ten Rings commander in Afghanistan
st: Abu Bakaar leads the Ten Rings' attack on Gulmira, and Iron Man leaves him to the mercy of the villagers.

entry.k: One of Sonny Burch's henchmen
st: Anitolov helps Burch hunt Hank's lab, until Burch's crew is dosed with its own truth serum and arrested.

entry.k: One of Sonny Burch's henchmen
st: Knox helps Burch hunt Hank's lab, until Burch's crew is dosed with its own truth serum and arrested.

entry.k: Warlord of the Booskan raiders
entry.op: Thor and the Guardians of the Galaxy
st: Habooska leads the Booskan raid on Indigarr, and dies when Thor joins the Guardians and crushes his army.

entry.k: One of the High Evolutionary's Recorders
st: Theel carries the passkey to Rocket's kill switch, and dies in the fall when Quill and Groot leap with him to Counter-Earth.

k: A member of the council that oversees S.H.I.E.L.D.
A powerful businessman and HYDRA leader
st: This councilman and the rest of the World Security Council go over Fury's head and fire a nuclear missile at Manhattan.
In season 3, Malick brings Hive back to Earth to lead HYDRA.
Under Hive's influence, Daisy kills Malick.

entry.k: Cottonmouth's muscle in Harlem
st: Zip provides muscle for Cottonmouth, and after his death Diamondback makes Zip one of his advisers.
Sent by Diamondback to kill Shades, Zip loses the fight, and Shades shoots him dead.

entry.k: An Italian crime boss eyeing Harlem
st: With Mariah jailed and Harlem's gangs at war, Luke warns Rosalie Carbone to keep her mob out of Harlem.

entry.k: Leaders of a Norse pagan hate group
st: In season 1, Jakob and Petra use a piece of the Asgardian Berserker staff to hunt the rest, until Ward and May beat them.

entry.k: Chan Ho Yin, a fire-wielding street performer
st: In season 1, Chan Ho Yin joins Raina's Centipede as Scorch, and May overloads his Extremis to kill him.

entry.k: A Kree warrior hunting the Diviners
st: In season 2, Vin-Tak tries to kill Skye, until Bobbi wipes his memory with his own weapon and Sif takes him home.

entry.k: A T.A.H.I.T.I. patient killing the others
st: In season 2, Derik hunts down fellow T.A.H.I.T.I. patients, until Coulson stops him and he is handed to the authorities.

entry.k: A senator, Grant Ward's older brother
st: In season 2, Senator Christian Ward pushes a multinational move against S.H.I.E.L.D., then trades it for custody of Grant.
Grant tortures Christian into confessing his past cruelty, then kills him and their parents.

entry.k: Grant Ward's HYDRA second-in-command
st: Kebo serves as Grant Ward's second-in-command in HYDRA, until Bobbi Morse kills him.

entry.k: A Momentum Labs scientist turned ghost
st: In season 4, Eli Morrow's machine turns Lucy Bauer into a ghost, and she goes after him until Ghost Rider destroys her.

entry.k: A Watchdog who turns out to be Inhuman
st: In season 4, Tucker Shockley turns Inhuman and explodes, killing Nadeer, until Daisy, Fitz and Simmons contain him.

entry.k: Madame Hydra's partner in the Framework
st: In season 4's Framework, Fitz is the Doctor, leading HYDRA with Madame Hydra, killing Agnes and torturing Radcliffe and Daisy.
Radcliffe sends him out of the Framework, and the real Fitz wakes up remembering every terrible thing he did.

entry.k: A junkyard boss on the Lighthouse
st: In season 5, Grill runs the Lighthouse junkyard and spies on the agents, until Flint kills him with his new rock powers.

entry.k: A 1931 speakeasy doorman, Gideon Malick's father
st: In season 7, S.H.I.E.L.D. saves Freddy from the Chronicoms, and he shoots Koenig to deliver a serum component to HYDRA.
By 1976, with the Chronicoms' help, Freddy rushes Project Insight into being, until Deke kills him.

entry.k: A War Department veteran serving the Council of Nine
st: In season 2, Vernon Masters does the Council of Nine's bidding, blocking the SSR and steering Jack Thompson.
Thompson hands Masters over to Whitney Frost, and she starts draining him with Zero Matter before she is interrupted.

entry.k: A silent Leviathan assassin
st: In season 1, Leviathan's Sasha Demidov kills Peggy's roommate and Brannis, then goes off a cliff in a truck as its weapons implode.

entry.k: A Ravager captain working for hire
entry.op: Howard the Duck and Darcy Lewis
st: Yondu steals Howard and Darcy's egg from the Grandmaster's cruise and delivers it to Kaecilius, who kills him.

entry.k: The Grandmaster's chief enforcer
st: Topaz locks up Tony and Gamora on Sakaar, and Valkyrie defeats her during Tony's race against the Grandmaster.

entry.k: A ruler of a broken Earth with a drone army
st: After the Emergence splits Earth, Quentin Beck seizes Stark Industries and rules the survivors with his Iron Federation drones.
Helped by the Watcher, Riri drains the nanites out of Beck's body, killing him and ending the Iron Federation.

entry.k: A zombified Emil Blonsky
st: A zombified Emil Blonsky storms the North Institute with Okoye's horde for the Queen of the Dead.

entry.k: A zombified Ava Starr
st: A zombified Ava Starr storms the North Institute with Okoye's horde, and Blade kills her.

entry.k: A zombified Steve Rogers
st: A zombified Steve Rogers storms the North Institute with Okoye's horde, and Alexei kills him.
